# Header Layout

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Header Layout

Since the logo and navigation links are aligned in a straight line, you can use a flexbox to align them.

```html
1<header class="header">
2    <div class="logo">Jane</div>
3    <nav class="nav">
4        <a href="#projects">Projects</a>
5        <a href="#contact">Contact</a>
6    </nav>
7</header>
```

```css
1.header {
2    display: flex;
3    padding: 10px min(5vw, 300px);
4    justify-content: space-between;
5    align-items: center;
6}
```

In the above code,

- display: flex enables flexbox on the header, allowing easy alignment of its child elements.
- justify-content: space-between places the logo on the left and navigation links on the right by spacing them out evenly.
- align-items: center centers items vertically in the header.

Let's style the logo and navigation links to make the header look more polished.
